name: Raymous Dapplewing
description: An owlin mage and military officer who served on the faculties of Lorehold and Silverquill and built the manor.

description_citations.text: "Captain Dapplewing's Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Captain Dapplewing builds the manor with his pension as a place to retire and host dinner parties.
timeline.quote: Using his generous pension, he built the home as a place to retire and host lavish dinner parties that often turned into late-night academic colloquiums.

citation.text: "Captain Dapplewing's Manor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On his death Dapplewing bequeaths the manor to Strixhaven University, which repurposes it as a faculty annex.
timeline.quote: Upon his passing, Captain Dapplewing bequeathed the manor to Strixhaven University.
